gui.clipboardtoolkit.unlock: Locked: click to unlock (copying out and checkboxes remain available)
message.clipboardtoolkit.locked: This clipboard is locked. Unlock it with the padlock button on the right.
message.clipboardtoolkit.scanned: Recorded %s item types on the clipboard.
message.clipboardtoolkit.not_blank: Use a blank clipboard. Existing content will not be overwritten.
message.clipboardtoolkit.unsupported: This block does not expose an item inventory.
message.clipboardtoolkit.too_large: Storage exceeds the scan limit (350 item types, 16,384 slots, or 2,147,483,647 items per type). Clipboard unchanged.
key.clipboardtoolkit.area: Start / confirm area selection (Shift to cancel)
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_start: Area selection: right-click the first corner. Shift + %s to cancel.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_first: First corner selected. Right-click the second corner.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_ready: Area selected. %s to record, right-click to change the end, Shift + %s to cancel.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_limit: Select at most 4,096 blocks with sides up to 64 blocks, within world height and border.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_far: Confirm within 64 blocks of both corners.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_unloaded: Part of the area or combined storage is not loaded. Move closer or reduce the selection.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_boundary: Combined storage extends outside the area. Include the entire double chest or Item Vault.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_loot: Open unopened loot containers before recording the area.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_material: Cannot convert a block to materials: %s. Clipboard unchanged.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_done: Area recorded. Placed blocks and stored items are saved in separate sections.
message.clipboardtoolkit.area_pages: The combined sections exceed 50 pages. Reduce the selection.
